SELECT a.sys06_menu_id AS menu_id , sys40_bookmark_id AS bookmark , TRIM(TRAILING sys06_menu_nm FROM f_menu_nm_allpath(a.sys06_menu_id)) AS parent_path_nm , a.sys06_menu_nm AS menu_nm , a.sys06_menu_no AS menu_no , a.sys06_note AS note , a.sys06_class_nm AS class_name , f_menu_nm_allpath(a.sys06_menu_id) AS menu_full_nm , a.sys06_parent_id , a.sys06_seq FROM sys06_menu a LEFT OUTER JOIN sys40_bookmark b ON (b.sys40_menu_id = a.sys06_menu_id AND b.sys40_person_id = #{userId} AND b.sys40_company_id = #{companyId}) INNER JOIN sys07_role_menu c ON a.sys06_menu_id = c.sys07_menu_id AND c.sys07_use_yn = 'true' INNER JOIN sys03_company_menu d ON a.sys06_menu_id = d.sys03_menu_id AND d.sys03_use_yn = 'true' INNER JOIN sys04_role e ON e.sys04_role_id = c.sys07_role_id AND e.sys04_company_id = #{companyId} INNER JOIN sys05_user_role f ON f.sys05_role_id = e.sys04_role_id WHERE sys07_role_id = sys05_role_id AND sys05_user_id = #{userId} AND sys03_company_id = #{companyId} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys50_specific_menu m LEFT JOIN sys51_specific_menu_person p ON p.sys51_specific_menu_id = m.sys50_specific_menu_id AND p.sys51_person_id = #{userId} WHERE m.sys50_company_id = #{companyId} AND m.sys50_menu_id = a.sys06_menu_id AND p.sys51_person_id IS NULL) AND sys06_parent_id != 0 AND CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(emp04_add_title_id) FROM emp04_add_title WHERE emp04_add_person_id = #{userId}) > 0 THEN COALESCE(a.sys06_add_title_use_yn,'false') = 'true' ELSE 1=1 END AND sys06_parent_id NOT IN (SELECT sys06_menu_id FROM sys06_menu WHERE sys06_parent_id = 0)
AND UPPER(CONCAT(a.sys06_menu_no,a.sys06_menu_nm)) LIKE UPPER(#{searchText})
AND UPPER(CONCAT(a.sys06_menu_no,a.sys06_menu_nm,a.sys06_note)) LIKE UPPER(#{searchText})
UNION SELECT a.sys06_menu_id AS menu_id , sys40_bookmark_id AS bookmark , TRIM(TRAILING sys06_menu_nm FROM f_menu_nm_allpath(a.sys06_menu_id)) AS parent_path_nm , a.sys06_menu_nm AS menu_nm , a.sys06_menu_no AS menu_no , a.sys06_note AS note , a.sys06_class_nm AS class_name , f_menu_nm_allpath(a.sys06_menu_id) AS menu_full_nm , a.sys06_parent_id , a.sys06_seq FROM sys06_menu a LEFT OUTER JOIN sys40_bookmark b ON (b.sys40_menu_id = a.sys06_menu_id AND b.sys40_person_id = #{userId} AND b.sys40_company_id = #{companyId}) INNER JOIN sys07_role_menu c ON a.sys06_menu_id = c.sys07_menu_id AND c.sys07_use_yn = 'true' INNER JOIN sys03_company_menu d ON a.sys06_menu_id = d.sys03_menu_id AND d.sys03_use_yn = 'true' INNER JOIN sys04_role e ON e.sys04_role_id = c.sys07_role_id AND e.sys04_company_id = #{companyId} WHERE sys03_company_id = #{companyId} AND sys04_company_id = sys03_company_id AND sys04_role_id = sys07_role_id AND sys04_default_role = 'true' AND sys06_parent_id != 0 AND CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(emp04_add_title_id) FROM emp04_add_title WHERE emp04_add_person_id = #{userId}) > 0 THEN COALESCE(a.sys06_add_title_use_yn,'false') = 'true' ELSE 1=1 END AND sys06_parent_id NOT IN (SELECT sys06_menu_id FROM sys06_menu WHERE sys06_parent_id = 0)
AND UPPER(CONCAT(a.sys06_menu_no,a.sys06_menu_nm)) LIKE UPPER(#{searchText})
AND UPPER(CONCAT(a.sys06_menu_no,a.sys06_menu_nm,a.sys06_note)) LIKE UPPER(#{searchText})
ORDER BY sys06_parent_id, sys06_seq, menu_full_nm

SELECT a.sys06_menu_id AS menu_id , NULL::numeric AS bookmark , NULL::text AS parent_path_nm , a.sys06_menu_nm AS menu_nm , a.sys06_menu_no AS menu_no , a.sys06_note AS note , a.sys06_class_nm AS class_name , f_menu_nm_allpath(a.sys06_menu_id) AS menu_full_nm FROM sys06_menu a WHERE sys06_parent_id != 0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys50_specific_menu m LEFT JOIN sys51_specific_menu_person p ON p.sys51_specific_menu_id = m.sys50_specific_menu_id AND p.sys51_person_id = #{userId} WHERE m.sys50_company_id = #{companyId} AND m.sys50_menu_id = a.sys06_menu_id AND p.sys51_person_id IS NULL) AND sys06_parent_id NOT IN (SELECT sys06_menu_id FROM sys06_menu WHERE sys06_parent_id = 0)
AND UPPER(CONCAT(sys06_menu_no,f_menu_nm_allpath(sys06_menu_id),sys06_class_nm)) LIKE UPPER(#{searchText})
AND UPPER(CONCAT(sys06_menu_no,f_menu_nm_allpath(sys06_menu_id),sys06_class_nm,sys06_note)) LIKE UPPER(#{searchText})
ORDER BY sys06_parent_id, sys06_seq, menu_full_nm
